author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have discovered that human brains can be preserved for thousands of years due to a unique chemical process occurring under low-oxygen conditions. This process causes brain proteins to form crosslinks that resist decay, differing from typical decomposition pathways. 

Source Article: https://pubs.acs.org/jprobs/article/25/8/4189/5164102/Molecular-Solution-to-the-Paradox-of-Ancient-Brain
